title: Design: Internal Work Orders report shows filters, cards and the work order tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have this month one closed internal work order, one closed no-charge work order and one invoiced billable work order with a no-charge line.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow4-05-05-internal-work-orders-report.png, iwo-happy-39-39-internal-work-orders-report.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports > Internal Work Orders.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 pixels wide.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Filters: date range, Location, Classification, Category, Original technician.
  • A summary strip shows one card per category: parts cost, count of work orders and lines, hours.
  • Two tabs, "By work order and line" (open) and "By technician"; columns in order: Work order, Line, Customer, Classification, Category, Original work order, Original technician, Closed / invoiced, Parts cost, Shop supplies, Hours; a totals row.

Step 2:

  • Nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off, and every label stays on its line as in the 1440 pixel view.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S9-R2: “The report "Internal Work Orders" under Reports lists the closed internal and no-charge work orders of the organization and, one row each, the no-charge lines of invoiced billable work orders. Filters: date range on the posting or invoice date (default this month, at most 12 months), Location (all or one), Classification (All / Internal / No Charge / No Charge line), Category (All or one, archived under a heading), Original technician (All or one). Above the table a summary strip shows one card per category in the range: parts cost, count of work orders and lines, hours. Two tabs. "By work order and line", columns: Work order (link), Line ("Whole work order", or the line number and title), Customer, Classification, Category, Original work order (link, with the original line number when set), Original technician, Closed / invoiced (the posting date, or the invoice date for a line), Parts cost (one number: stock parts plus special orders and sublet, as on the NO CHARGE document, S3-R5; for a line, its own parts), Shop supplies (empty on a line), Hours (the labor hours on the lines, as on the document; clocked hours per technician are in Technician Efficiency with Only internal); a totals row for the whole range, not the page; rows sorted by date, newest first. "By technician", one row per technician with the columns Completed lines (lines with status Complete in the range on which the technician clocked time, the definition Technician Efficiency uses, so the two reports agree), Comeback lines and Warranty lines (no-charge lines of those categories whose stored original technicians include this technician, S2-R17), Comeback rate (comeback lines / completed lines), Redo hours and Redo parts cost (the hours and parts cost of that comeback and warranty work). A whole no-charge Comeback or Warranty work order counts as one line in this tab, with all its hours and parts cost. A line with several technicians counts once for each of them, in the numerator and the denominator, hours and cost shown whole for each; the totals row counts every line once; a note under the table says so. A row "Unassigned" holds the work without an original technician (Not in ShopView, or no technician on the original). The dollar cost of labor arrives with labor posting. Export: the PDF carries both tabs as sections with the same columns; the CSV carries the tab that is open, as every export gives what is on screen.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 4 · Find internal and no-charge work orders" / "Happy flow v6", boards "05 Internal Work Orders report" (Flow 4 · Find internal and no-charge work orders), "39 Internal Work Orders report" (Happy flow v6).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • iwo-flow4-05-05-internal-work-orders-report.png
  • iwo-happy-39-39-internal-work-orders-report.png

The design's own words:

  • “By work order and line”
  • “By technician”
  • “Original technician”
  • “Closed / invoiced”
  • “Whole work order”

Difference: the design's card adds shop supplies into parts cost (IWO-D43, settled by S9-R2); empty cells (IWO-D44, question 15) and wrapping numbers (IWO-D45, question 16) are each held as their own design-version case.
